name: Dark painted epics
description: Painterly concept art: megastructures, ruins and cathedral-like towers, tiny figures, ochre and dusty teal, some eerie dream-paintings.
light: low dusty sunlight or a single distant glow through haze
composition: huge structure filling the frame, tiny human figure at the base, deep atmospheric perspective
camera_or_medium: oil or digital painting with visible brushwork
mood: awe with a touch of dread, silent
texture_detail: weathered stone, dust, organic growth on architecture
subjects: a cathedral-sized tower in a dust storm
ruins of a megastructure overgrown with roots
a tiny pilgrim before a colossal gate
a city carved into a canyon wall
